A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 23-page paper, including Appendices A–O. Text and rendering comparisons establish identical research content; differences are confined to first-page date and version information.

before.justification: v1 reports original multilingual-model evaluations, domain-transfer experiments, direction-weight analyses and on-policy RL results in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original empirical results, including the main experiments in Tables 1–5 and supplementary results in Tables 8–16.

M1.justification: The structured reward, DCO objective, bilingual procedure and N-language extension in Section 4 and Appendix E are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use MMMLU, XCSQA and BMLAMA, plus GSM8K in the on-policy pilot, with identical language, domain and test-scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Section 6.1 and Table 1 retain the same SFT, DPO and CALM baselines and the DPO-followed-by-DCO comparison. Comparator membership is unchanged throughout.

E3.justification: The model configurations, train/test counts, sampling procedures, training settings and evaluation protocols in Sections 5–6 and Appendices G–I are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same domain-transfer experiments, direction-weight sensitivity studies, changed-answer analyses and entropy case study, including their supplementary evidence.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is identical: Table 1 reports standard errors, while Table 2 labels its uncertainties as standard deviations. No run-count, seed or statistical-estimation information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and reported findings match, including Tables 1–5 and 8–16 and Figures 2–8. No result entries are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: Definition 1, Lemmas 1–3, mathematical assumptions, equations and the proofs and derivations in Appendices D–E are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about consistency guarantees, empirical benefits, complementarity with DPO, domain generalization and directional control.

C2.justification: Interpretations of accuracy transfer, BMLAMA gains and direction-weight tradeoffs are unchanged. The on-policy pilot's scope limitations and Appendix K's application guidance are also identical.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters and data-sampling instructions in Appendices G–H are unchanged. The code-release statement and repository URL also remain identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works and bibliography are unchanged, including the paper's positioning relative to CALM and DPO.

P1.justification: The first-page preprint date changes from March 6 to May 11, 2026. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated March 4 to v2 dated May 7, 2026. All other wording and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–16, captions and page layout are unchanged. The first-page date and version-text updates do not change the visual organization.

improvement.justification: Only first-page date/version information and the corresponding arXiv self-link are updated. The scientific content, appendix evidence, explanations, reproducibility information and visual organization remain identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
